| Category = Asparagus recipes

{{recipe}} 

== Ingredients ==
* 1 tbsp unsalted [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]]
* ½ medium [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]], finely [[Cookbook:Dice|diced]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Mincing|minced]] [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]]
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]
* Freshly-ground [[Cookbook:Pepper|black pepper]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Pound|pound]] fresh [[Cookbook:Asparagus|asparagus]], trimmed of tough ends

== Procedure ==
#Melt butter with olive oil in a large straight-sided [[Cookbook:Sauté Pan|sauté pan]] over medium high heat. Add onion and cook, stirring, until translucent.
#Add garlic and cook, stirring, until golden.
#Add a [[Cookbook:Pinch|pinch]] of salt and some freshly ground black pepper, and cook 1 more minute.
#Add asparagus and season mixture liberally with kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper. [[Cookbook:Sautéing|Sauté]] until asparagus is lightly browned around edges.
#Check for taste and adjust seasoning if desired. Serve warm.
